Both condition populations and observed coverage of every heldout unit required; all-zero spike group explicitly undefined.

Train/eval source windows and continuous blocks must not overlap; conflicting native splits reject without dropping trials.

Smoothing fails unsupported missingness/all-zero training units/final nonconvergence; no imputation or hidden alternate fit.
One session supports descriptive outputs only; no between-animal uncertainty or latent-causal inference.
